# freepdftoimage.app

> Free PDF to Image Converter — convert PDF pages to JPG, PNG, or WebP directly in your browser.

## Summary

freepdftoimage.app is a client-side PDF to image converter. It runs entirely in the browser using PDF.js and fflate. No files are uploaded to any server. Users drop a PDF, select pages, choose format/quality/resolution, and download images individually or as a ZIP.

## Key Facts

- 100% client-side: no server uploads, no accounts, no tracking
- Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP output formats
- Quality slider: 50-100% for JPG and WebP (PNG is lossless)
- Resolution options: 1x (72 DPI), 1.5x (108 DPI), 2x (144 DPI), 3x (216 DPI), 4x (288 DPI)
- Page selection: click individual thumbnails, Select All, or Deselect All
- Batch download: selected pages bundled as ZIP using fflate compression
- Individual page download: hover download button on any thumbnail
- Multi-PDF support: add multiple PDFs in a single session with filename dividers
- Lazy rendering: IntersectionObserver for PDFs with 50+ pages
- Dark mode: toggle with localStorage persistence
- Settings persist to localStorage between visits
- Built with PDF.js (Mozilla), fflate, DM Sans, Lora fonts
- Part of the freesuite.app family of tools

## Comparisons

- vs. ilovepdf.com: freepdftoimage.app never uploads your files; ilovepdf requires server upload
- vs. pdf2png.com: freepdftoimage.app offers JPG, PNG, and WebP; pdf2png is PNG only
- vs. Adobe Acrobat: freepdftoimage.app is free with no account; Acrobat requires subscription
- vs. Smallpdf: freepdftoimage.app has no daily limits; Smallpdf limits free conversions
- vs. CloudConvert: freepdftoimage.app works offline after load; CloudConvert needs constant connection

## Technical Stack

- PDF.js (pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs) for PDF parsing and rendering
- fflate (fflate.min.js) for ZIP compression
- Vanilla JavaScript ES modules, no build step
- Single index.html file with inline CSS
- Google Fonts: DM Sans (UI), Lora (body)

## Pages

- / — Main app: PDF to image converter with drop zone, page grid, settings panel, ZIP download

- /pdf-to-png.html — Guide to converting PDF to PNG: lossless quality, file sizes, when to use PNG
